items.name: 06b-ledged-door-open-inside
items.prompt: Edit this photo: keep the same hallway, staircase, camera position and lighting. Open the sage green ledged under stairs cupboard door: it swings out into the hallway on its black T hinges on the left vertical edge, so we see the back of the door with the same angled top edge. Inside the cupboard is now visible and tidy: the sloping underside of the stairs as the ceiling, a small warm LED strip light, three coats on a row of hooks at the tall end, a stick vacuum standing in a wall bracket, and two plain woven baskets on a low shelf at the short end. Keep the door the same size and shape as the opening. No people, no text, no logos. Photorealistic.

items.name: 06c-inside-cupboard-lit
items.prompt: Looking straight into a tidy under stairs cupboard in a British house through its open doorway; the door itself is out of frame. The cupboard ceiling is the sloping underside of the stairs, high on the left and low on the right, with a warm LED strip light running along it. At the tall left end three coats hang on a row of simple black hooks; in the middle a plain white cordless stick vacuum with no branding hangs in a wall bracket off the floor; at the low right end two plain woven baskets sit on a low white shelf. Cream painted walls inside, oak floor, a painted cream door frame around the opening. Photorealistic interior photography, real estate photo, cottage meets Scandinavian farmhouse style, palette of white oak, cream, sage green and soft terracotta, realistic proportions, clean and calm, no people, no text, no logos, no brand names, high detail.
